chunks: The Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, said:
"The first thing with which one begins in the Hereafter is the charity of water"—meaning in reward.

key_terms.أَوَّلُ: first; foremost in rank or precedence
key_terms.الْآخِرَةِ: the Hereafter, where deeds are recompensed
key_terms.الْأَجْرِ: reward; the intended meaning clarified in the report
key_terms.الْمَاءِ: water; the specific object of charity mentioned
key_terms.صَدَقَةُ: charity given for the sake of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the first charity to be rewarded in the Hereafter according to Imam Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام teaches that giving water in charity holds a foremost rank in reward in the Hereafter. The hadith highlights the great merit of relieving a fundamental human need and points to the lasting spiritual reward of such charity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1722 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"The first thing to be rewarded in the Hereafter is the charity of providing water."
